title: Armed forces in Haiti kill at least 34 gang members to regain control of key corridor
paragraphs: Armed forces in Haiti kill at least 34 gang members to regain control of key corridor

Haitian security forces launched a major offensive on Thursday to retake Martissant, a strategic corridor linking Port-au-Prince with the country's western and southern regions that gangs have controlled for five years. Police said at least 34 suspected gang members were killed in clashes involving a private security task force.
Armed forces in Haiti launched an aggressive operation on Thursday to remove powerful gangs long entrenched in a key corridor that connects the country’s capital to its western and southern regions.
